description: Date and time calculations in pure code. op=diff: calendar years, months and days between two dates, and the total days. op=add or subtract: move a date by years, months, weeks, days, hours or minutes (month ends are clamped). op=info: weekday, ISO week, day of year, quarter, and age from birthDate. op=tz: a local date-time in one IANA time zone shown in another. Impossible dates are a 400 with the reason. Price: $0.001 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

asOf.description: info: the date the age is counted to, default today (UTC)

birthDate.description: info: date of birth YYYY-MM-DD, for the age

from.description: diff: start date YYYY-MM-DD; tz: local date-time YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM

from_zone.description: tz: IANA zone of the given time, e.g. Europe/Berlin

op.description: diff, add, subtract, info or tz

to_zone.description: tz: IANA zone to show, e.g. America/New_York

unit.description: add, subtract: years, months, weeks, days (default), hours or minutes

name: date_calc
title: Date Calc
